text: Bank of England cuts its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 3.75% following a 5-4 MPC vote, with markets showing limited immediate reaction.

meta.note: Close vote margin indicates internal divergence despite the executed policy action.

text: Delayed data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics shows November CPI at 2.7% year-over-year and core CPI at 2.6%, both below forecasts, with incomplete inputs due to the government shutdown.

meta.note: Missing October CPI limits comparability and constrains confidence in trend interpretation.

text: Micron Technology reports earnings and guidance far above expectations, citing sold-out high-bandwidth memory capacity, elevated capex plans, and sustained data center demand, driving a double-digit stock increase.

meta.note: Demand-supply imbalance is management-stated; duration and normalization timing are not observable at this snapshot.
